resolution.note: Selection of data-file readers already held (literal path match plus evidenceTests since #819); added real-repo proof test for AGENTS.md, standards/records.json, spec/context-budget.json

title: npm run fast selects tests that read a changed data file such as AGENTS.md
body:
Why: PR #850 (t-m1ak2s4) changed AGENTS.md; npm run fast PASSed locally but CI run 43618415681 failed test/brain/standards.test.ts, which checks that standards/records.json evidence 'AGENTS.md#KRN-08' still holds its fragment. fast selects tests by import graph and name, not by the repository files a test reads (AGENTS.md, spec/*.json, standards/*.json).
Outcome: fast also selects every test whose source names a changed non-code repository path (literal path string match), so a data-file change runs its readers.
Proof: test/fast-check.test.ts: a change to AGENTS.md selects test/brain/standards.test.ts on the real repository.
